newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: New Zealand share prices turn negative at close.
newsitem.headline: New Zealand share prices turn negative at close.

text.p: * Telecom takes a dive, drags NZ market down at close
* Other leaders soften slightly
* Volatility seen continuing next week
Price movements at close
LAST CHG * NZSE40 cap index -14.78 at 2,366.29
349 -1 * NZSC cap index -26.52 at 5,105.00
338 -2 * NZMC .NZMC cap index -4.54 at 1,907.17
370 nil * Volume NZ$87.2 million. Futures 1,200, unch
707 -13 * Other movers - +2 +2
A sharp decline in market leader Telecom drove the New Zealand share market down at the close while other leaders were only marginally softer.
The NZSE-40 Capital Index fell 14.78 points to 2,366.29 but turnover, at NZ$87.2 million, was again high.
Brokers were at a loss to explain Telecom's 13-cent fall to NZ$7.07, except to say that Telecom may have been driven up too far, too fast, and out of kilter with most valuations.
The market opened strongly after another record close on Wall Street but quickly ran out of steam, Paul Nicolson at SBC Warburg said.
"I think it was just purely the market running out of orders after a relatively active week and a few stocks stocks just caved," he said.
"It's just a case of our market having a reasonable run in the last little while and it feels pretty close to fair value relative to bond prices," he said.
"So inspite of the Dow continuing to run hard, there does not appear to be too much steam in our market at this stage."
Nicolson said he expected more volalitility next week but with limited upside.
"I don't think you'll see much upside in the short term. This week, it's been all over the place and I think we'll just continue to see the market range trading next week," he said.
-- James Gray, Auckland newsroom +64 9 302 1253
